suspects.text: I was just in the bakery waiting, to buy a loaf of bread. I come in every week ask anybody! I wasn’t even near the register when the money went missing.
I’m throwing a party, tomorrow, so I was buying baked goods for my guests. I got a dozen cupcakes two dozen cookies and a chocolate cake. I paid the full amount, I promise!

I don’t know why you’re questioning me. I’ve worked at the bakery for years. I took the money put all of it into the register went to grab the order and came back. It must have gotten stolen while my back was turned.
lies: put all of it into the register
